image.title: London Board of Health searching the city for cholera, 1832
image.creator: Unknown (lithograph, Wellcome Collection)
image.attribution: Wellcome Collection, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: A lithograph from the same pandemic two years earlier: a city's health board hunting for the disease

summary.en: The second worldwide wave of cholera, which spread from India through Asia, Russia and Europe between 1826 and 1837 and reached Spain in the 1830s. Doctors of the time did not know how the disease spread.
